metadata.title: Complete AI Model Inventory: SLMs & LLMs (Merged)

classification_rules.SLM: ≤20B dense parameters OR ≤20B active parameters in MoE architectures
classification_rules.LLM: >20B dense parameters, closed API without disclosed count, or MoE with >20B active

slm.name: RedPajama-INCITE-7B
slm.architecture_notes: One of the first fully open models with open training data, code, and weights.

slm.name: Phi-1
slm.architecture_notes: Trained on 'textbook-quality' synthetic data. Focused on Python coding.

slm.name: Phi-1.5
slm.architecture_notes: Extended Phi-1 to general reasoning and language understanding tasks.

slm.name: Fuyu-8B
slm.architecture_notes: Novel multimodal architecture that feeds image patches directly to the transformer without a vision encoder.

slm.name: Qwen-Audio
slm.architecture_notes: First large audio-language model from Alibaba, handling diverse audio understanding tasks.
slm.training_data: 30+ audio tasks and various audio types

slm.name: Gemini 1.0 Nano
slm.architecture_notes: Designed for on-device use. Available on Pixel 8 Pro.

slm.name: Mistral Tiny (Mistral-7B-Instruct)
slm.architecture_notes: API-hosted version of Mistral 7B Instruct, branded as Mistral Tiny in the API.

slm.name: Phi-2
slm.architecture_notes: Near state-of-the-art performance among models under 13B parameters.

slm.name: OLMo-1B
slm.architecture_notes: Smallest OLMo variant, fully open for research reproducibility.

slm.name: DeepSeek-Math-7B
use_cases: Competitive with 10x larger models in math
slm.architecture_notes: Math-specialized model that introduced the GRPO algorithm later used in DeepSeek-R1.

slm.name: StableLM 2 12B
slm.architecture_notes: Largest StableLM 2 variant, trained on English, Spanish, German, Italian, French, Portuguese, and Dutch.
slm.training_data: 2T tokens of multilingual and code data

slm.name: Gemma-7B
slm.architecture_notes: Google's first open model family built from Gemini technology.

slm.name: BitNet b1.58
slm.architecture_notes: Pioneering 1-bit quantization approach that matches full-precision models at similar scale.

slm.name: DeepSeek-VL-7B
slm.architecture_notes: DeepSeek's vision-language model combining SigLIP and SAM encoders.

slm.name: RecurrentGemma-2B
slm.architecture_notes: Novel architecture combining linear recurrence with local attention for efficient inference.

slm.name: OpenELM
slm.architecture_notes: Apple's first open-source LLM family. Includes full training framework.

slm.name: PaliGemma
slm.architecture_notes: Inspired by PaLI-3, combines SigLIP vision encoder with Gemma language model.

slm.name: Aya 23-8B
slm.architecture_notes: Open multilingual model covering 23 languages with strong cross-lingual transfer.

slm.name: Apple Foundation Model (On-Device)
slm.architecture_notes: Powers on-device Apple Intelligence features. Uses adapters to specialize for different tasks.

slm.name: SmolLM
slm.architecture_notes: State-of-the-art for sub-2B parameter models.

slm.name: Minitron-8B
use_cases: 40x fewer training tokens than from scratch
slm.architecture_notes: Compressed from Nemotron-4-15B using pruning and distillation techniques.

slm.name: SmolLM-135M
slm.architecture_notes: Smallest SmolLM variant designed for research into tiny language models.

slm.name: GPT-4o mini
slm.architecture_notes: Replaced GPT-3.5 Turbo as the default affordable model.

slm.name: Gemma 2-2B
slm.architecture_notes: Smallest Gemma 2 variant, distilled from the 27B model.
slm.training_data: 2T tokens from web data, code, mathematics

slm.name: Aya Expanse-8B
use_cases: Data arbitrage and synthetic data strategies
slm.architecture_notes: Next generation of Aya with improved training strategies for multilingual performance.
slm.training_data: Multilingual data for 23 languages with synthetic data augmentation

slm.name: Gemma-3n-E2B-IT
slm.architecture_notes: Selective parameter activation

slm.name: Gemma-3n-E4B-IT
slm.architecture_notes: Selective parameter activation

slm.name: SmolLM3-3B
slm.architecture_notes: Extensible to 128K context

slm.name: InternLM3-8B
slm.architecture_notes: Third generation InternLM with deep thinking capabilities.

slm.name: Granite 3.2-8B
slm.architecture_notes: IBM's open-source enterprise model with explicit thinking mode for step-by-step reasoning.
slm.training_data: 12T tokens of code, language, academic data

slm.name: Granite 3.2-2B
slm.architecture_notes: Smallest Granite 3.2 model for edge and on-device deployment.
slm.training_data: 12T tokens of code, language, academic data

slm.name: Llama 4 Scout
slm.architecture_notes: MoE, 16 experts, 17B active per token

slm.name: Ministral-3B-Instruct-2512
slm.architecture_notes: 3.4B LM + 0.4B vision encoder

slm.name: Mistral Small 4 (119B)
slm.architecture_notes: 128 experts, 6B active per token (8B incl. embedding), Apache 2.0, 40% faster than 3.2

slm.name: Gemma 4 E2B
slm.architecture_notes: MatFormer nested sub-model; Per-Layer Embeddings; ~2B effective params; on-device

slm.name: Gemma 4 E4B
slm.architecture_notes: MatFormer; PLE; ~4B effective params; integrated thinking mode

slm.name: Gemma 4 26B (MoE)
slm.architecture_notes: Mixture-of-experts variant; thinking mode; ranks in top open models on Arena

slm.name: Granite 4.0 Micro
slm.architecture_notes: Dense transformer; edge/laptop-class; ISO/IEC 42001 accredited

slm.name: Granite 4.0 H-Micro
slm.architecture_notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/transformer (~9:1); fast edge execution

slm.name: Granite 4.0 H-Tiny
slm.architecture_notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/transformer + fine-grained MoE; 1B active of 7B; >70% memory reduction vs transformer

slm.name: Granite 4.0 H-Small
slm.architecture_notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/transformer + MoE; 9B active of 32B; enterprise workloads

slm.name: Granite 4.0 Nano 1B
slm.architecture_notes: Ultra-compact; browser / on-device inference

slm.name: Granite 4.0 Nano 350M
slm.architecture_notes: Ultra-compact hybrid; browser / on-device inference

slm.name: Falcon-H1-0.5B
slm.architecture_notes: Parallel hybrid: attention + Mamba-2 heads within one mixer block

slm.name: Falcon-H1-1.5B
slm.architecture_notes: Parallel attention + Mamba-2 hybrid; 1.5B and 1.5B-deep variants

slm.name: Falcon-H1-3B
slm.architecture_notes: Parallel attention + Mamba-2 hybrid

slm.name: Falcon-H1-7B
slm.architecture_notes: Parallel attention + Mamba-2 hybrid; competitive with larger transformers at long context

slm.name: LFM2-350M
slm.architecture_notes: Hybrid: gated short convolutions + GQA blocks; up to 2x faster CPU prefill/decode

slm.name: LFM2-700M
slm.architecture_notes: Hybrid conv + GQA; edge-optimized

slm.name: LFM2-1.2B
slm.architecture_notes: Hybrid conv + GQA; flagship on-device model of the initial LFM2 release

slm.name: LFM2-2.6B
slm.architecture_notes: Larger dense LFM2 variant

slm.name: LFM2-8B-A1.5B (MoE)
slm.architecture_notes: Mixture-of-experts LFM2; 1.5B active of 8.3B total

llm.name: InstructGPT
llm.architecture_notes: Sibling of ChatGPT, trained with RLHF to follow instructions better.

llm.name: Luminous Supreme
llm.architecture_notes: European-built LLM focused on data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

llm.name: BLOOM
llm.architecture_notes: Largest open-source multilingual model at time of release. Trained by 1000+ researchers across 60 countries.

llm.name: Flan-T5
llm.architecture_notes: Instruction-tuned version of T5. Part of Google's Flan collection.

llm.name: Flan-PaLM
llm.architecture_notes: Instruction-tuned PaLM. Showed that instruction tuning scales well.

llm.name: Galactica
llm.architecture_notes: Scientific LLM trained on papers, textbooks, knowledge bases. Withdrawn after controversy over accuracy.

llm.name: GPT-3.5 (text-davinci-003)
llm.architecture_notes: Underlying model for the initial ChatGPT launch on Nov 30, 2022.

llm.name: GPT-3.5-Turbo
llm.architecture_notes: Powered the original ChatGPT. Became the most widely used LLM API.

llm.name: LLaMA-7B
llm.architecture_notes: First LLaMA release. Leaked weights led to massive open-source ecosystem.

llm.name: LLaMA-13B
llm.architecture_notes: Outperformed GPT-3 (175B) on many benchmarks despite being 13x smaller.

llm.name: Claude 1
llm.architecture_notes: Anthropic's first commercial model. Trained with Constitutional AI (CAI).

llm.name: Claude Instant 1
llm.architecture_notes: Lighter, faster, cheaper version of Claude 1.

llm.name: GPT-4
llm.architecture_notes: Major leap in reasoning. First to score near human-level on many professional exams.

llm.name: ChatGLM-6B
llm.architecture_notes: Popular bilingual chatbot in China. Can run on consumer GPUs.

llm.name: Cerebras-GPT-13B
llm.architecture_notes: Family of compute-optimal models trained entirely on Cerebras custom hardware.

llm.name: Vicuna-13B
llm.architecture_notes: Fine-tuned LLaMA on ShareGPT conversations. Claimed 90% ChatGPT quality.

llm.name: Pythia-12B
llm.architecture_notes: Suite of models designed for studying training dynamics, with all checkpoints publicly released.

llm.name: StableLM-Alpha
llm.architecture_notes: Stability AI's first language model release. Base models CC BY-SA-4.0, instruct models CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

llm.name: StarCoder
llm.architecture_notes: Trained on The Stack dataset. 80+ programming languages.

llm.name: MPT-7B
llm.architecture_notes: Used ALiBi for efficient long-context support. MosaicML later acquired by Databricks.

llm.name: PaLM 2
llm.architecture_notes: Powered Bard and Google AI services. Smaller but smarter than PaLM 1.

llm.name: Falcon-40B
llm.architecture_notes: Ranked #1 on Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard for two months after launch.

llm.name: Claude 2
llm.architecture_notes: Major upgrade with 100K context window. Improved coding and math capabilities.

llm.name: Llama-2-7B
llm.architecture_notes: First LLaMA model released for commercial use. Partnership with Microsoft.

llm.name: Llama-2-70B
llm.architecture_notes: Largest Llama 2 model. Competitive with many proprietary models.

llm.name: Code Llama-7B
llm.architecture_notes: Fine-tuned from Llama 2 on code datasets.

llm.name: Jais-13B
llm.architecture_notes: World's best Arabic LLM at launch, joint effort between UAE and Cerebras.
llm.training_data: 395B tokens of Arabic and English text

llm.name: Yi-34B
llm.architecture_notes: Strong bilingual model from 01.AI, founded by Kai-Fu Lee.

llm.name: DeepSeek-Coder-V1
llm.architecture_notes: Trained on 87% code and 13% natural language.

llm.name: Cohere Embed v3
llm.architecture_notes: Leading embedding model supporting compression for cost-efficient retrieval.

llm.name: Grok-1
llm.architecture_notes: xAI's first model, founded by Elon Musk. Open-sourced weights in March 2024.

llm.name: GPT-4 Turbo
llm.architecture_notes: Major update with 128K context, lower prices, and vision capability.

llm.name: Samsung Gauss
llm.architecture_notes: Samsung's in-house generative AI. Initially for internal use only.

llm.name: Claude 2.1
llm.architecture_notes: Doubled context to 200K tokens. 2x reduction in hallucination rates.

llm.name: Mixtral-8x7B
llm.architecture_notes: Released via torrent link. Matched GPT-3.5 performance at fraction of compute cost.

llm.name: Gemini 1.0 Pro
llm.architecture_notes: Mid-tier Gemini model. Powered Google Bard.

llm.name: SOLAR-10.7B
use_cases: Merged and scaled from Llama 2 architecture
llm.architecture_notes: Novel DUS technique that scales model depth by merging layers from base models.

llm.name: DeepSeek-LLM-67B
llm.architecture_notes: DeepSeek's first generation base model before the V-series.

llm.name: Mistral Embed
llm.architecture_notes: Embedding model for retrieval, classification, and clustering tasks.

llm.name: GLM-4
llm.architecture_notes: Zhipu AI's flagship model. Competitive with GPT-4.

llm.name: Nous Hermes 2 Mixtral
llm.architecture_notes: Community fine-tune of Mixtral with enhanced instruction following and function calling.

llm.name: Yi-VL-34B
llm.architecture_notes: Multimodal extension of Yi-34B adding vision capabilities.

llm.name: OLMo-7B
llm.architecture_notes: First OLMo release. All training artifacts publicly available.

llm.name: Smaug-72B
use_cases: #1 on HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard at launch
llm.architecture_notes: First open model to exceed average 80 on HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard.
llm.training_data: Fine-tuned from Qwen 72B with DPO on new math-focused pairwise dataset

llm.name: Gemini 1.0 Ultra
use_cases: first to exceed human expert on MMLU
llm.architecture_notes: First model to claim human-expert performance on MMLU (90.0%).

llm.name: Reka Flash
llm.architecture_notes: 21B parameter multimodal model competitive with Gemini Pro and GPT-3.5.

llm.name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
llm.architecture_notes: First model with 1M token production context window. MoE architecture.

llm.name: Jais-30B
llm.architecture_notes: Scaled up Jais with improved Arabic and English capabilities.

llm.name: Mistral Large (initial)
llm.architecture_notes: Mistral's first proprietary flagship model.

llm.name: Mistral Small (2402)
llm.architecture_notes: API-only model positioned between Tiny and Medium in capability.

llm.name: Claude 3 Opus
llm.architecture_notes: Most capable Claude 3 model. Introduced three-tier model naming.

llm.name: Inflection 2.5
use_cases: 94% of GPT-4 performance with 40% of compute
llm.architecture_notes: Significant upgrade powering Pi chatbot, approaching GPT-4 with much less compute.

llm.name: Claude 3 Haiku
llm.architecture_notes: Fastest and most affordable Claude 3 model.

llm.name: Nemotron-4-15B
llm.architecture_notes: Mid-size Nemotron model trained on massive 8T token dataset.
llm.training_data: 8T tokens of English, multilingual, and code data

llm.name: Grok-1.5
llm.architecture_notes: Significant upgrade from Grok-1 with doubled context and stronger reasoning.

llm.name: Grok-1.5 Vision
llm.architecture_notes: First multimodal Grok model, introduced alongside RealWorldQA benchmark.

llm.name: Reka Core
llm.architecture_notes: Reka's largest model. Competitive with GPT-4V on multimodal benchmarks.

llm.name: WizardLM-2-8x22B
llm.architecture_notes: Uses Evol-Instruct method to progressively enhance instruction-following capability.

llm.name: Llama-3-8B
llm.architecture_notes: Major architecture upgrade. 15T training tokens, up from 2T in Llama 2.

llm.name: Llama-3-70B
llm.architecture_notes: Competitive with GPT-4 on many benchmarks.

llm.name: Snowflake Arctic
llm.architecture_notes: Enterprise-focused MoE model. Trained for just $2M on 1000 GPUs in 3 months.

llm.name: DeepSeek-V2
llm.architecture_notes: Introduced Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for efficient KV cache.

llm.name: Granite Code-34B
llm.architecture_notes: Code-focused LLM trained on 116 programming languages, Apache 2.0 licensed.
llm.training_data: 3.5-4.5T tokens of code and language data in 116 programming languages

llm.name: Yi-Large
llm.architecture_notes: 01.AI's flagship API model, positioned as competitive with top global models.

llm.name: Gemini 1.5 Flash
llm.architecture_notes: Distilled from Gemini 1.5 Pro for faster, cheaper inference.

llm.name: Falcon 2-11B
llm.architecture_notes: Outperformed Meta's Llama 3 8B per Hugging Face Leaderboard.

llm.name: Aya 23-35B
llm.architecture_notes: Larger Aya variant for higher-quality multilingual tasks.

llm.name: CogVLM2-19B
llm.architecture_notes: Second-generation visual language model from Zhipu/Tsinghua.

llm.name: Apple Foundation Model (Server)
llm.architecture_notes: Server-side model running on Apple silicon in Private Cloud Compute for more complex tasks.

llm.name: DeepSeek-Coder-V2
llm.architecture_notes: First open-source model to match GPT-4 Turbo on coding tasks.

llm.name: InternLM2.5-20B
llm.architecture_notes: Larger InternLM2.5 variant with strong tool-calling and reasoning capabilities.

llm.name: Falcon Mamba-7B
llm.architecture_notes: First production SSM-based language model from a major lab.

llm.name: Grok-2
llm.architecture_notes: Significant upgrade over Grok-1. Image generation capability added.

llm.name: o1-preview
llm.architecture_notes: First 'reasoning' model. Thinks before responding. Major advance in math/science.

llm.name: o1-mini
llm.architecture_notes: Smaller, faster, cheaper reasoning model.

llm.name: Pixtral-12B
llm.architecture_notes: Mistral's first multimodal model.

llm.name: Palmyra Creative
llm.architecture_notes: Specialized Palmyra model for creative content generation with brand voice control.

llm.name: Molmo-72B
llm.architecture_notes: State-of-the-art open multimodal model. Can point at and count objects.

llm.name: Inflection 3 Pi
llm.architecture_notes: Powers the Pi conversational AI assistant.

llm.name: Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B
llm.architecture_notes: NVIDIA's custom fine-tune of Llama 3.1-70B focused on helpfulness and accuracy.

llm.name: Aya Expanse-32B
llm.architecture_notes: Larger Aya Expanse model, competitive with Gemma, Mistral, and Llama in multilingual tasks.
llm.training_data: Multilingual data for 23 languages with synthetic data augmentation

llm.name: Baichuan 4
llm.architecture_notes: Latest generation Baichuan model with significant capability improvements.

llm.name: GLM-4-Voice
llm.architecture_notes: Voice-capable GLM model supporting real-time speech dialogue.

llm.name: Hunyuan-Large
use_cases: Largest open MoE model at launch
llm.architecture_notes: Largest open-source MoE model at launch, developed by Tencent.

llm.name: Pixtral Large
llm.architecture_notes: Integrates 1B parameter visual encoder with Mistral Large 2.

llm.name: Tülu 3-8B
llm.architecture_notes: State-of-the-art open post-training recipe using SFT + DPO + RLVR.

llm.name: OLMo 2-7B
llm.architecture_notes: Best fully-open language model at release. All training data, code, and logs released.

llm.name: QwQ-32B-Preview
llm.architecture_notes: Alibaba's answer to OpenAI o1. Reasoning-focused model.

llm.name: o1
llm.architecture_notes: Full release of o1 with vision and function calling. Replaced o1-preview.

llm.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash (Experimental)
llm.architecture_notes: First Gemini with native multimodal output (text, images, audio).

llm.name: Falcon 3
llm.architecture_notes: First Falcon with multimodal capabilities.

llm.name: QvQ-72B-Preview
llm.architecture_notes: Visual reasoning model similar to QwQ but with image understanding.

llm.name: MiniMax-01
llm.architecture_notes: One of the longest context windows of any open model. Uses hybrid linear-softmax attention.

llm.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B
use_cases: top open reasoning model for 2x H100

llm.name: Kimi k1.5
llm.architecture_notes: Reasoning model trained with RL on long-context data, rivaling o1 on math benchmarks.

llm.name: o3-mini
llm.architecture_notes: First in the o3 family. On par with o1 at lower latency.

llm.name: Mistral Saba
use_cases: Middle Eastern and South Asian language focus
llm.architecture_notes: Regional model optimized for Middle Eastern and South Asian languages.

llm.name: OLMo 2-32B
use_cases: outperforms GPT-3.5 Turbo and GPT-4o mini
llm.architecture_notes: First fully-open model to outperform GPT-3.5 Turbo and GPT-4o mini.

llm.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite
llm.architecture_notes: First-ever Gemini Flash-Lite designed for cost-efficiency and speed.

llm.name: QwQ-32B
llm.architecture_notes: Open-weight reasoning model competitive with DeepSeek-R1 and o1-mini.

llm.name: Qwen2.5-Omni-7B
llm.architecture_notes: First Qwen model with both text and audio output capabilities.

llm.name: Palmyra X5
llm.architecture_notes: Trained with synthetic data for $1M. Absorbs 1M token prompt in ~22 seconds.

llm.name: Claude Opus 4
use_cases: world's best coding model at launch

llm.name: o3-pro
llm.architecture_notes: Version of o3 that thinks longer for most reliable responses. Replaced o1-pro.

llm.name: GLM-4.5
llm.architecture_notes: Most advanced open-source MoE model from China at release.

llm.name: Nemotron 3 Nano-30B
llm.architecture_notes: Most compute-cost-efficient model. Hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE architecture.

llm.name: Nemotron 3 Super
llm.architecture_notes: Hybrid Mamba-Attention MoE, 120B total, 12B active
